posts.author: mayvidbowie
posts.body:
Hello! So, in RPG Maker 2003, there is an option in the Enemies tab to make enemies "Flying" (Which is a cosmetic effect in battles, where the enemy will appear to be floating up and down)
I was curious, since this feature is absent from VX Ace, does anybody know how to recreate this effect? It's a cool little thing I like from RPGM2k3 and I'd be great if I would be able to have a way to use it in VX Ace. Thanks!!!
